## Chapter 3 · Turbulence and Turbulence Modelling {#ch3}

| Quantity | Expression | Notes |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Critical Reynolds number (pipe) | $Re_{\text{crit}} = \left(\dfrac{UD}{\nu}\right)_{\text{crit}} \approx 2300$ | [§3.1](../notes/ch3.qmd#sec-history); depends on inlet disturbances, lower bound $\approx 2000$ |
| Dissipation rate (per unit mass) | $\varepsilon = 2\nu\, s_{ij}s_{ij},\quad s_{ij} = \dfrac{1}{2}\left(\dfrac{\partial u_i}{\partial x_j} + \dfrac{\partial u_j}{\partial x_i}\right)$ | [§3.3](../notes/ch3.qmd#sec-characteristics); summed over $i, j$ (full Cartesian form in the notes); largest where eddies are smallest |
| Dissipation set by the large eddies | $\varepsilon \sim \dfrac{u_l^3}{l}$ | [§3.4](../notes/ch3.qmd#sec-energy-cascade); independent of $\nu$ |
| Kolmogorov scales (from $\nu$, $\varepsilon$) | $\eta = \left(\dfrac{\nu^3}{\varepsilon}\right)^{1/4},\; u_\eta = (\nu\varepsilon)^{1/4},\; \tau_\eta = \left(\dfrac{\nu}{\varepsilon}\right)^{1/2}$ | [§3.4.2](../notes/ch3.qmd#sec-kolmogorov-hypotheses); $u_\eta\eta/\nu = 1$ |
| Inertial-subrange eddies | $u(\ell) \sim (\varepsilon\ell)^{1/3},\; \tau(\ell) \sim (\ell^2/\varepsilon)^{1/3}$ | [§3.4.2](../notes/ch3.qmd#sec-kolmogorov-hypotheses); $l \gg \ell \gg \eta$ |
| Energy and dissipation spectra | $k = \displaystyle\int_0^\infty E(\kappa)\,d\kappa,\quad \varepsilon = \int_0^\infty 2\nu\kappa^2E(\kappa)\,d\kappa$ | [§3.4.3](../notes/ch3.qmd#sec-five-thirds); $\kappa = 2\pi/\ell$ |
| Kolmogorov $-5/3$ law | $E(\kappa) = C_K\,\varepsilon^{2/3}\kappa^{-5/3},\quad C_K \approx 1.5$ | [§3.4.3](../notes/ch3.qmd#sec-five-thirds); inertial subrange $1/l \ll \kappa \ll 1/\eta$ |
| Kolmogorov scales (from large scales) | $\eta \sim l\,Re^{-3/4},\; u_\eta \sim u_l\,Re^{-1/4},\; \tau_\eta \sim \tau_l\,Re^{-1/2}$ | [§3.5](../notes/ch3.qmd#sec-length-scales); $Re = u_l l/\nu$, $\tau_l = l/u_l$ |
| Scale separation | $l/\eta \sim Re^{3/4}$ | [§3.5](../notes/ch3.qmd#sec-length-scales); DNS grid $N^3 \gtrsim Re^{9/4}$, cost $\sim Re^3$ ([§3.8.1](../notes/ch3.qmd#sec-dns)) |
| Reynolds decomposition | $u = U + u',\quad U = \dfrac{1}{T}\displaystyle\int_0^T u\,dt,\quad \overline{u'} = 0$ | [§3.6](../notes/ch3.qmd#sec-reynolds-averaging); same for $v, w, p$ |
| Turbulence intensity | $T_I = \dfrac{\sqrt{\overline{u'^2}}}{U_\infty}\;\left(= \dfrac{\sqrt{2k/3}}{U_\infty}\text{ if isotropic}\right)$ | [§3.6](../notes/ch3.qmd#sec-reynolds-averaging) |
| Turbulent kinetic energy | $k = \tfrac{1}{2}\left(\overline{u'^2} + \overline{v'^2} + \overline{w'^2}\right)$ | [§3.6](../notes/ch3.qmd#sec-reynolds-averaging); per unit mass |
| Averaging rules | $\overline{fg} = FG + \overline{f'g'},\quad \overline{f'G} = 0,\quad \overline{\partial f/\partial s} = \partial F/\partial s$ | [§3.6.1](../notes/ch3.qmd#sec-averaging-rules) |
| Reynolds stresses | $T_{ij} = -\rho\,\overline{u_i'u_j'}$, e.g. $T_{xy} = -\rho\overline{u'v'}$ | [§3.6.2](../notes/ch3.qmd#sec-turbulent-stresses); symmetric, 6 unknowns |
| Mean and fluctuating continuity | $\del\cdot\vect{Q} = 0,\quad \del\cdot\vect{q}' = 0$ | [§3.7](../notes/ch3.qmd#sec-rans); $\vect{Q} = (U, V, W)$ |
| RANS ($x$-momentum) | $\rho\dfrac{DU}{Dt} = -\dfrac{\partial P}{\partial x} + \mu\del^2U - \rho\left(\dfrac{\partial\overline{u'^2}}{\partial x} + \dfrac{\partial\overline{u'v'}}{\partial y} + \dfrac{\partial\overline{u'w'}}{\partial z}\right)$ | [§3.7](../notes/ch3.qmd#sec-rans); 4 equations, 10 unknowns |
| Boussinesq hypothesis | $-\rho\overline{u_i'u_j'} = \mu_t\left(\dfrac{\partial U_i}{\partial x_j} + \dfrac{\partial U_j}{\partial x_i}\right) - \dfrac{2}{3}\rho k\,\delta_{ij}$ | [§3.9.2](../notes/ch3.qmd#sec-boussinesq); $\mu_t$ is not a fluid property |
| Eddy viscosity (general) | $\mu_t = C_1\rho\, l_s v_s$ | [§3.9.2](../notes/ch3.qmd#sec-boussinesq) |
| Mixing length model | $-\rho\overline{u'v'} = \rho\, l_m^2\left\lvert\dfrac{\partial U}{\partial y}\right\rvert\dfrac{\partial U}{\partial y}$ | [§3.9.3](../notes/ch3.qmd#sec-mixing-length); e.g. $l_m = 0.07\delta$ (mixing layer) |
| One-equation model | $\mu_t = C_\mu\rho\, l_s k^{1/2},\quad \varepsilon = k^{3/2}/l_s$ | [§3.9.4](../notes/ch3.qmd#sec-one-equation) |
| Production of $k$ (2D) | $P_k = \mu_t\left\{2\left(\left[\dfrac{\partial U}{\partial x}\right]^2 + \left[\dfrac{\partial V}{\partial y}\right]^2\right) + \left(\dfrac{\partial U}{\partial y} + \dfrac{\partial V}{\partial x}\right)^2\right\}$ | [§3.9.4](../notes/ch3.qmd#sec-one-equation) |
| $k$ equation | $\rho\dfrac{Dk}{Dt} = \del\cdot\left(\dfrac{\mu_t}{\sigma_k}\del k\right) + P_k - \rho\varepsilon$ | [§3.9.4](../notes/ch3.qmd#sec-one-equation) |
| $\varepsilon$ equation | $\rho\dfrac{D\varepsilon}{Dt} = \del\cdot\left(\dfrac{\mu_t}{\sigma_\varepsilon}\del \varepsilon\right) + C_{1\varepsilon}\dfrac{\varepsilon}{k}P_k - C_{2\varepsilon}\rho\dfrac{\varepsilon^2}{k}$ | [§3.9.5](../notes/ch3.qmd#sec-k-epsilon) |
| $k$--$\varepsilon$ eddy viscosity | $\mu_t = C_\mu\rho\dfrac{k^2}{\varepsilon}$ | [§3.9.5](../notes/ch3.qmd#sec-k-epsilon) |
| $k$--$\varepsilon$ constants | $C_\mu = 0.09,\ \sigma_k = 1.0,\ \sigma_\varepsilon = 1.3,\ C_{1\varepsilon} = 1.44,\ C_{2\varepsilon} = 1.92$ | [§3.9.5](../notes/ch3.qmd#sec-k-epsilon); fitted to experimental data |
| $k$--$\omega$ eddy viscosity | $\mu_t = \rho k/\omega$ | [§3.10](../notes/ch3.qmd#sec-other-models) |
